media.title: Siegfried Arno in Schatz, mach’ Kasse, 1926
media.altText: Photograph of the actor Siegfried Arno in a scene from the silent film Schatz, mach’ Kasse.
media.publicCaption: Siegfried Arno in the Ama-Film comedy Schatz, mach’ Kasse (1926), in a photograph printed in the magazine Das Leben and cropped from a scene still with Ossi Oswalda. Five years later he sang the refrain of Kaper’s “Ach, Otto, Otto...!” with Marek Weber’s orchestra for Electrola.
media.publicCreditLine: Photographer unknown; Das Leben 4, no. 7 (January 1926/27), via Wikimedia Commons.
media.rightsNote: Public domain. The photograph carries no photographer’s credit and was published in 1926, more than seventy years ago, which places an anonymous work out of copyright in the European Union; publication before 1 January 1931 places it out of copyright in the United States.

personNameVariants.publicNote: The Berlin form of the actor’s name, under which he sang on German records before his emigration; the Library of Congress heading gives the later American form Sig Arno.
